intro: Explore rental income, financing and ownership costs with transparent calculations. Adjust the assumptions to your own scenario.
private: Calculated in your browser. No data is sent or saved.
sample: Starting values are fictional examples. Enter amounts in TL and rates in percent (2 means 2%).
resultHint: Change the inputs, then calculate to update this breakdown.
stale: Inputs changed. Calculate again to refresh the results.
error: Calculation could not be completed. Check the highlighted field and numeric limits.
fieldError: Check this value: use the required format and a value within the allowed range.
limits: Amounts: non-negative, at most two decimals. Price, principal, fee base, area and regional average: greater than zero. Rates: 0–100% (return and inflation may exceed 100%). Months: 1–1200; years: 1–1000.
presetNote: Reference rates may change. Verify them before use. Fixed charges start at zero because they need a quote; zero does not mean free. The 4% agent rate is the total ceiling before VAT, shared 50/50 here. Fees are never applied automatically.
presetApplied: Reference rates applied. Fixed charges still need your quotes.
advice: For planning only. This is not legal, tax or financial advice. Results are estimates, not offers or valuations.
rounding: Integer kuruş · each monetary charge rounded half away from zero
sourceAgent: Ministry of Trade · brokerage fees, Article 20
optionRent: Rent has the lower modeled cost
optionBuy: Buy has the lower modeled cost

notes.rental: Gross yield = annual rent ÷ price. Net yield subtracts vacancy loss and owner-paid costs. Excludes income tax, financing and acquisition fees. Enter only the dues paid by the owner.
notes.payback: Undiscounted rent-only recovery. Rent rises once per year; the final year is interpolated linearly. No expenses, financing or resale value. A projection limit is not a guarantee of recovery.
notes.mortgage: Annuity uses the monthly interest rate plus interest-based BSMV/KKDF. Each month's interest and taxes are rounded separately; the last payment clears the balance. Zero tax defaults do not determine exemption. Small loans may have irregular payments due to rounding. Other bank charges are excluded.
notes.purchase: Buyer and seller deed rates are separate. Enter the applicable deed fee base; the calculator does not determine the statutory minimum. Brokerage is calculated on price, VAT on brokerage; the buyer share applies to the VAT-inclusive fee. Fixed charges are assigned to the buyer.
notes.real: Fisher: (1 + nominal return) ÷ (1 + inflation) − 1. Enter rates for the same period. This version accepts non-negative scenario rates; the real result may be negative.
notes.sqm: Price ÷ area, rounded to kuruş/m². Difference = (price per m² − regional average) ÷ regional average. Use comparable areas and your own regional estimate; no market data is fetched.
notes.rentBuy: Cash purchase with constant home value and rent. Buying cost = upfront fees + ownership costs + simple opportunity cost on price plus upfront fees. Home value is retained, so the price itself is not treated as a loss. No loan, appreciation, rent growth, compounding or sale costs. This is a cost comparison, not a full wealth simulation.
